_comment: Vectors for RequiredCommitmentOf (Go) and requiredCommitmentOf (TypeScript), asserted by both sender-auth suites. Each vector is a payment request, as the text a caller holds, an optional solana escrow domain, left out when none is supplied, optional tronChainIds, the verifier's own Tron chain ids by cluster, left out when none are supplied, and either want, the commitment the function must return, or result, the complete CommitmentResult its refusal must carry. The function returns what any deposit for the request must commit. When signed_messages[0] carries a message_prehash, even a blank one, it runs the check VerifyRequestCommitment runs and refuses exactly as it does: each such vector expects VerifyRequestCommitment's result for the same request and domain, which matches the commitment-vectors.json row with the same request and domain where there is one, and both suites assert that equality. Otherwise no signed commitment can be read (sender_auth or signed_messages is absent, or signed_messages[0] has no message_prehash, absent or null): it applies only the request's own rules, reads no Solana domain, never compares message_scheme and verifies no signature, so a request it accepts there may still be unpayable. Written by hand: each honest want is what the matching honest payment in commitment-vectors.json signed, and each other value follows from the rules in readme.md. Edit this file directly; there is nothing to regenerate.
